gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.
'Optimistic' is the adjective; 'optimism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.
